Northwind Robotics to Acquire Contoso Sensors

SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Northwind Robotics, Inc. (NASDAQ: NWRB) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Contoso Sensors, Inc. for $38.00 per share in cash, representing a total enterprise value of approximately $4.2 billion.

The transaction brings Contoso's lidar and depth-sensing technology in-house and is expected to be accretive to Northwind's adjusted gross margin within the first full year after closing.

"This is a natural next step in a partnership that has shaped our products for years," said Maria Alvarez, Chief Executive Officer of Northwind Robotics. "Together we will deliver safer, smarter automation to our customers."

The Boards of Directors of both companies have unanimously approved the transaction, which is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals and the approval of Contoso stockholders.

Northwind intends to finance the transaction through a combination of cash on hand and committed debt financing.

About Northwind Robotics

Northwind Robotics designs autonomous mobile robots for warehouses, distribution centers and factories.
